2609.25542.title: DefaultGNN: A Dual-Perspective GNN Framework for Predicting Corporate Default from Buyer-Seller Transaction Networks
2609.25542.paper_summary: Corporate default prediction is a core problem in financial risk management, yet traditional credit models rely heavily on financial statements that are often sparse or unavailable for many firms. Corporate transaction networks offer a complementary view of real economic activity, but how risk propagates through buyer-seller relationships remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study using real-world electronic tax-invoice data spanning six years that links transaction histories with default events, revealing that transaction-driven risk is both role-dependent (buyer or seller) and scale-dependent. Based on these findings, we construct multiplex buyer-view and seller-view transaction networks and propose DefaultGNN, a dual-perspective graph neural network-based framework for corporate default prediction. DefaultGNN integrates both views to model how risk flows through transactional relationships, achieving strong improvements over both attribute-based and graph-based baselines, especially for firms with limited intrinsic risk signals. We further provide interpretable network-based explanations by visualizing how distressed trading partners contribute to default risk. In collaboration with a licensed credit rating agency, we validate that DefaultGNN's predictions complement existing credit scoring models, improving approval rates by 7-11%p without increasing default risk among approved firms. The source code can be found at https://github.com/jhkim611/DefaultGNN
2609.25542.paper_summary_zh: 企業違約預測是金融風險管理中的核心問題，但傳統的信用模型在很大程度上依賴於往往稀疏或無法獲得的財務報表。企業交易網絡提供了對實際經濟活動的補充視角，但風險如何通過買賣關係傳播仍然未被充分探索。我們進行了一項大規模的實證研究，使用涵蓋六年的真實電子稅務發票數據，將交易歷史與違約事件聯繫起來，揭示了基於交易的風險既依賴於角色（買方或賣方），也依賴於規模。根據這些發現，我們構建了多重買方視角和賣方視角的交易網絡，並提出了DefaultGNN，一種基於雙視角圖神經網絡的企業違約預測框架。DefaultGNN整合了這兩個視角，以建模風險如何在交易關係中流動，並在基於屬性和基於圖形的基準上實現了顯著的改進，特別是對於內在風險信號有限的企業。我們還通過可視化困境交易夥伴如何對違約風險作出貢獻，提供了可解釋的基於網絡的解釋。與一家持牌信用評級機構合作，我們驗證了DefaultGNN的預測補充了現有的信用評分模型，提高了7-11%的批准率，而不增加已批准企業的違約風險。源代碼可以在 https://github.com/jhkim611/DefaultGNN 找到。
